items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: I stayed with Georgie Auld about three months.

ctx.x: I stayed with Georgie Auld about three months. And then, I was going through some changes then, I guess that was just a period in my life where I couldn't get really adjusted, somehow. But the job with Georgie Auld swung every night. And I'm not saying, once again, not because I was great but that sound, it really made it.

I went to...I was gonna...I had planned to go back to New York. Because, in answer to the original plan, we had talked it over a few times in Hamp's band with...you had the little in crowd with...you always had your little circle group within a big...
